overview: 今日共收录7篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Antiferromagnetic ordering, superconductivity and electron–phonon coupling in a layered ( Mn 2 / 3 Ru 1 / 3 ) 2 AlC i -LAX phase
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Antiferromagnetic ordering, superconductivity and electron–phonon coupling in a layered ( Mn 2 / 3 Ru 1 / 3 ) 2 AlC i -LAX phase
full_list.abstract: Publication date: 25 October 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 275 Author(s): Saeedeh Mohammadi, Aliasghar Shokri, Mohammad Javad Mahmoodi
full_list.summary: 该论文研究层状(Mn₂/₃Ru₁/₃)₂AlC i-MAX相中的反铁磁有序、超导性及电子-声子耦合，重点分析其磁性与超导相关性质。主要结论应包括该材料的磁基态、超导倾向以及电子-声子相互作用对相关物性的影响。
full_list.focus_summary: 该论文研究层状(Mn₂/₃Ru₁/₃)₂AlC i-MAX相中的反铁磁有序、超导性及电子-声子耦合，重点分析其磁性与超导相关性质。主要结论应包括该材料的磁基态、超导倾向以及电子-声子相互作用对相关物性的影响。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、电子-声子耦合、超导和第一性原理计算方向直接相关。其磁性基态、交换相互作用和电子-声子耦合分析可借鉴，并可进一步结合自旋哈密顿量或机器学习方法研究有限温度磁性与相变。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步核查其是否系统比较了不同磁构型、磁交换参数和声子软化机制，并阅读其电子-声子耦合与超导参数的计算细节。后续可开展自旋-晶格耦合、非共线磁性及温度依赖超导性质的计算研究。
full_list.method_point: 现有条目只提供题名、作者、期刊和研究对象，摘要中没有给出计算或实验方法，因而无法可靠判定是否采用 DFT、DFT+U、超导密度泛函、线性响应电子-声子耦合或机器学习模型。针对该层状（Mn2/3Ru1/3）2AlC i-LAX 相，完整技术路线至少应明确化学无序构型、磁性初始态、交换关联泛函、U 参数、k 点与平面波截断，并报告声子谱、费米面耦合常数及由 Eliashberg 或 McMillan 方程得到的 Tc。
full_list.related_work: 该问题与 Hongjun Xiang 关于反铁磁、自旋哈密顿量和自旋-晶格耦合的方向直接呼应，也连接 Xin-Gao Gong、Ji-Hui Yang 关注的电子-声子耦合、Wannier 插值和输运计算。与 NbOI2、CrI3、CrSBr 等低维磁性或极性体系相比，本材料的核心差异是 Mn/Ru 混占层状 MAX 结构中的磁有序与超导竞争；与 BaTiO3 铁电研究相比，则缺少极化翻转这一主线。现有信息没有证据表明使用 equivariant GNN、MACE 或 NEP，因此不能把该文归入 ML 方法学进展。
full_list.implication: 可先按化学无序超胞生成不同 Mn/Ru 排布，使用 DFT+U 比较铁磁、层内反铁磁和层间反铁磁态，并计算自旋-晶格扰动下的力常数、声子谱、Wannier 电子结构及 Eliashberg 谱函数。随后以这些高精度构型、能量、力、应力和局域磁矩训练带自旋或磁矩条件的 equivariant GNN/MACE，使用 NEP 作为大规模分子动力学基线；在不同超胞、磁序和温度下交叉验证能量误差、声子频率、磁交换参数与 Tc，另以独立 DFT+U 和实验晶格常数、磁转变温度作外部检验。

full_list.title_en: Dominant Role of Solid Matrix and Persistent Free Radicals in Cr(VI) Reduction by Biochar
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dominant Role of Solid Matrix and Persistent Free Radicals in Cr(VI) Reduction by Biochar
full_list.abstract: Biochar has emerged as a promising material for remediating toxic hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI)), yet the distinct roles of its soluble components and solid matrix remain poorly understood. This study systematically investigated the mechanisms of Cr(VI) immobilization by rice husk biochar produced at different pyrolysis temperatures (200–600°C). The biochar pyrolyzed at 400°C (RH400) exhibits the highest Cr(VI) reduction efficiency, effectively converting Cr(VI) to less toxic Cr(III). Through comparative experiments with biochar leachate and the residual solid matrix, we demonstrate that the soluble leachate does not contribute to Cr(VI) reduction, but instead antagonizes total chromium immobilization by competing for sorption sites. In contrast, the washed solid residue (WRH400) serves as the primary active component, achieving a 2.4-fold higher total Cr immobilization capacity than pristine RH400. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) analysis identifies carbon-centered persistent free radicals (PFRs) as the key electron donors for Cr(VI) reduction. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) further reveals that this reduction process is accompanied by oxidation of the biochar matrix, with a shift of PFRs from carbon-centered to carbon/oxygen-centered species. This work conclusively identifies the biochar solid matrix and its associated PFRs as the dominant drivers for Cr(VI) reductive immobilization and suggests that pre-washing biochar can optimize its performance in environmental remediation.

full_list.title_en: Initial Conformation Governs Amyloid-β42 Dynamics and Association at a POPC Membrane-Water Interface
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Initial Conformation Governs Amyloid-β42 Dynamics and Association at a POPC Membrane-Water Interface
full_list.abstract: The conformational heterogeneity of amyloid-β42 (Aβ42) may influence its early interactions with lipid membranes, yet the extent to which different initial structures determine subsequent membrane association remains unclear. Here, three nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) derived Aβ42 monomer structures (1IYT, 1Z0Q, and 6SZF) were examined at a 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-phosphocholine (POPC) membrane-water interface. Despite an identical environment, the monomers followed different trajectories during comparative 200-ns all-atom molecular dynamics simulations using the CHARMM36m force field. The predominantly α-helical 1IYT structure underwent substantial relaxation, with α-helical content decreasing from 78.57% to 44.77%. The 1Z0Q monomer exhibited extensive rearrangement, developing 18.45% π-helical structure. In contrast, the fibril-derived 6SZF structure remodeled toward an α-helical state, increasing from 11.90% to 41.59%. Structural evolution and membrane association were evaluated using root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), fluctuation (RMSF), radius of gyration, peptide-membrane distance, interfacial contacts, hydrogen bonding, and secondary-structure analysis. These findings demonstrate that the initial conformational state of Aβ42 strongly influences its structural response to a common lipid-water environment and emphasize the importance of starting-structure selection when modeling early amyloid-membrane interactions.

full_list.title_en: Synergistic Dual-Reinforcement of Carbon Fiber/Polycarbonate Thermoplastic Composites via Molecularly Designed Interfacial Modification and Interlaminar Nano-Bridging
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Synergistic Dual-Reinforcement of Carbon Fiber/Polycarbonate Thermoplastic Composites via Molecularly Designed Interfacial Modification and Interlaminar Nano-Bridging
full_list.abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced thermoplastic (CFRTP) composites present a recyclable alternative to traditional thermosets, yet fully realizing their structural potential remains constrained by the chemical incompatibility between commercial epoxy-based sizing on the surface of carbon fibers and high-viscosity thermoplastic matrices such as polycarbonate (PC). To overcome this bottleneck, this study introduces a multiscale synergistic dual-reinforcement strategy that couples molecularly designed interfacial modification with strategic interlaminar nano-bridging. First, a sol-gel surface modifier was molecularly designed to replace conventional sizing. This specific design constructs a reactive polysiloxane network on the carbon fiber surface, promoting robust secondary bonding and molecular chain entanglement with the PC matrix while compensating for viscosity limitations during impregnation. Concurrently, a highly dispersed multi-walled carbon nanotube (MWCNT)/PC nanofilm was interleaved at the theoretical neutral plane, establishing a localized nano-bridging and crack-deflection defense network without altering bulk melt rheology. Integrated with automated fiber placement (AFP) prepreg manufacturing, the dual-reinforced composites (MWCNTs/MCF/PC) were systematically evaluated across varying matrix melt flow indices. Compared to unmodified CFRTP baselines, the dual-reinforced laminates demonstrated significant concurrent enhancements in ultimate tensile strength (+ 23.01%), flexural strength (+ 25.10%), and interlaminar shear strength (+ 27.18%). Fractographic morphology verified a fundamental shift in the failure mechanism from interfacial adhesive debonding to energy-dissipating cohesive matrix failure. Furthermore, thermogravimetric analysis revealed a 20.01°C elevation in the maximum degradation temperature (Tmax) due to a tortuous nano-labyrinth barrier effect that restricts volatile gas diffusion. Overall, this study establishes a comprehensive framework bridging interfacial chemistry, failure physics, and automated processing to realize high-performance, fully recyclable thermoplastic composites for advanced industrial applications.

core_items.title_en: Antiferromagnetic ordering, superconductivity and electron–phonon coupling in a layered ( Mn 2 / 3 Ru 1 / 3 ) 2 AlC i -LAX phase
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Antiferromagnetic ordering, superconductivity and electron–phonon coupling in a layered ( Mn 2 / 3 Ru 1 / 3 ) 2 AlC i -LAX phase
core_items.abstract: Publication date: 25 October 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 275 Author(s): Saeedeh Mohammadi, Aliasghar Shokri, Mohammad Javad Mahmoodi
core_items.summary: 该论文研究层状(Mn₂/₃Ru₁/₃)₂AlC i-MAX相中的反铁磁有序、超导性及电子-声子耦合，重点分析其磁性与超导相关性质。主要结论应包括该材料的磁基态、超导倾向以及电子-声子相互作用对相关物性的影响。
core_items.focus_summary: 该论文研究层状(Mn₂/₃Ru₁/₃)₂AlC i-MAX相中的反铁磁有序、超导性及电子-声子耦合，重点分析其磁性与超导相关性质。主要结论应包括该材料的磁基态、超导倾向以及电子-声子相互作用对相关物性的影响。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、电子-声子耦合、超导和第一性原理计算方向直接相关。其磁性基态、交换相互作用和电子-声子耦合分析可借鉴，并可进一步结合自旋哈密顿量或机器学习方法研究有限温度磁性与相变。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步核查其是否系统比较了不同磁构型、磁交换参数和声子软化机制，并阅读其电子-声子耦合与超导参数的计算细节。后续可开展自旋-晶格耦合、非共线磁性及温度依赖超导性质的计算研究。
core_items.method_point: 现有条目只提供题名、作者、期刊和研究对象，摘要中没有给出计算或实验方法，因而无法可靠判定是否采用 DFT、DFT+U、超导密度泛函、线性响应电子-声子耦合或机器学习模型。针对该层状（Mn2/3Ru1/3）2AlC i-LAX 相，完整技术路线至少应明确化学无序构型、磁性初始态、交换关联泛函、U 参数、k 点与平面波截断，并报告声子谱、费米面耦合常数及由 Eliashberg 或 McMillan 方程得到的 Tc。
core_items.related_work: 该问题与 Hongjun Xiang 关于反铁磁、自旋哈密顿量和自旋-晶格耦合的方向直接呼应，也连接 Xin-Gao Gong、Ji-Hui Yang 关注的电子-声子耦合、Wannier 插值和输运计算。与 NbOI2、CrI3、CrSBr 等低维磁性或极性体系相比，本材料的核心差异是 Mn/Ru 混占层状 MAX 结构中的磁有序与超导竞争；与 BaTiO3 铁电研究相比，则缺少极化翻转这一主线。现有信息没有证据表明使用 equivariant GNN、MACE 或 NEP，因此不能把该文归入 ML 方法学进展。
core_items.implication: 可先按化学无序超胞生成不同 Mn/Ru 排布，使用 DFT+U 比较铁磁、层内反铁磁和层间反铁磁态，并计算自旋-晶格扰动下的力常数、声子谱、Wannier 电子结构及 Eliashberg 谱函数。随后以这些高精度构型、能量、力、应力和局域磁矩训练带自旋或磁矩条件的 equivariant GNN/MACE，使用 NEP 作为大规模分子动力学基线；在不同超胞、磁序和温度下交叉验证能量误差、声子频率、磁交换参数与 Tc，另以独立 DFT+U 和实验晶格常数、磁转变温度作外部检验。

core_direction_note: 本日条目聚焦层状（Mn2/3Ru1/3）2AlC i-LAX 相中的反铁磁有序、超导与电子-声子耦合，但摘要未报告机器学习模型、训练数据或等变神经网络计算。其材料对象也不是 NbOI2、CrI3、CrSBr 或 BaTiO3，因此不能据此宣称铁电极化、磁畴动力学或 ML 势函数取得进展。若要纳入团队技术路线，应以 DFT+U 和自旋结构计算建立基准，再用 equivariant GNN、MACE 或 NEP 扩展磁性声子与有限温度模拟。
